description: Focused mutations used to audit every required issue #58 outcome without duplicating the full evidence document.

scenarios.name: PASS
scenarios.mutation: none

scenarios.name: unit profile
scenarios.mutation: testProfile = unit and determinism is reasoned N/A

scenarios.name: integration profile
scenarios.mutation: testProfile = integration and determinism has two matching runs

scenarios.name: weighted integration failure
scenarios.mutation: the 0.15 positive dimension scores zero

scenarios.name: weighted unit failure
scenarios.mutation: unit determinism is N/A and the 0.15 positive dimension scores zero

scenarios.name: NON_CONFORMANT
scenarios.mutation: sourceConformance = NON_CONFORMANT

scenarios.name: SOURCE_DEFECT
scenarios.mutation: sourceValidity = SOURCE_DEFECT, sourceNotes is present, and sourceEvidence quotes the defective assertion against the observed value

scenarios.name: SOURCE_DEFECT without sourceEvidence
scenarios.mutation: sourceValidity = SOURCE_DEFECT with sourceNotes but no sourceEvidence

scenarios.name: SOURCE_CONFLICT
scenarios.mutation: sourceValidity = SOURCE_CONFLICT with a traced additional source and sourceEvidence quoting both sources

scenarios.name: SOURCE_CONFLICT without sourceEvidence
scenarios.mutation: sourceValidity = SOURCE_CONFLICT with two authoritative sources but no sourceEvidence

scenarios.name: SOURCE_CONFLICT node-versus-value
scenarios.mutation: sourceValidity = SOURCE_CONFLICT citing only expect(list.head.value).toEqual(1) from one spec, observed value is an Element object

scenarios.name: SOURCE_CONFLICT agreeing expectations
scenarios.mutation: sourceValidity = SOURCE_CONFLICT with two sources expecting the same value and a failing observed value; the mismatch is implementation behaviour

scenarios.name: SOURCE_CONFLICT two-source evidence
scenarios.mutation: sourceValidity = SOURCE_CONFLICT with two authoritative sources quoting disagreeing expectations for the same subject list.head and a failing observed value; one quote (toBeInstanceOf) is not mechanically checkable, so sourceEvidenceStatus is REVIEWER_REQUIRED and the unresolved conflict gate stays closed

scenarios.name: SOURCE_CONFLICT relabelled expected
scenarios.mutation: sourceValidity = SOURCE_CONFLICT with two authoritative sources quoting the identical assertion expect(list.head).toEqual(1) but expected values 1 and 3; each expected must match its quoted literal, so the second entry is rejected

scenarios.name: SOURCE_CONFLICT verified literal disagreement
scenarios.mutation: sourceValidity = SOURCE_CONFLICT with two authoritative sources quoting expect(list.head.value).toBe(1) and expect(list.head.value).toBe('1') with matching expected values 1 and '1' and a failing observed value; sourceEvidenceStatus is VERIFIED and the unresolved conflict gate stays closed

scenarios.name: SOURCE_CONFLICT unrelated assertions
scenarios.mutation: sourceValidity = SOURCE_CONFLICT quoting expect(foo).toEqual(1) from one source and expect(bar).toEqual(3) from another; unequal expectations about different subjects

scenarios.name: malformed input
scenarios.mutation: requirements is not an array

scenarios.name: unexpected input
scenarios.mutation: one unexpectedInput check is FAIL

scenarios.name: error handling
scenarios.mutation: one errorHandling check is SKIPPED

scenarios.name: nondeterministic output
scenarios.mutation: run-2 output differs from run-1

scenarios.name: auditable N/A
scenarios.mutation: a check is N/A with a written reason

scenarios.name: skipped test
scenarios.mutation: a required check is SKIPPED
